+:root {
+  --primary: #4e342e;
+  --secondary: #d7ccc8;
+  --accent: #ffab40;
+  --text: #3e2723;
+  --light: #fafafa;
+  --muted: #6d5b55;
+  --danger: #b3261e;
+  --success: #2e6b30;
+  --border: #e6dcd8;
+}
+
+* {
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  margin: 0;
+  padding: 0;
+}
+
+body {
+  font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
+  line-height: 1.6;
+  color: var(--text);
+  background-color: var(--light);
+}
+
+/* Navigation (shared look with the homepage) */
+nav {
+  background: var(--primary);
+  color: white;
+  padding: 1rem 5%;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
+  justify-content: space-between;
+  align-items: center;
+  position: sticky;
+  top: 0;
+  z-index: 1000;
+}
+
+.logo {
+  font-size: 1.5rem;
+  font-weight: bold;
+  letter-spacing: 1px;
+}
+
+nav ul {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  gap: 0.25rem 20px;
+  list-style: none;
+}
+
+nav a {
+  color: white;
+  text-decoration: none;
+  font-size: 0.9rem;
+  transition: color 0.3s;
+}
+
+nav a:hover,
+nav a[aria-current="page"] {
+  color: var(--accent);
+}
+
+.logout-link {
+  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
+  padding: 5px 12px;
+  border-radius: 4px;
+}
+
+/* Header */
+.account-hero {
+  min-height: 28vh;
+  background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)),
+    url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1447933601403-0c6688de566e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1350&q=80');
+  background-size: cover;
+  background-position: center;
+  color: white;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  justify-content: center;
+  align-items: center;
+  text-align: center;
+  padding: 40px 20px;
+}
+
+.account-hero h1 {
+  font-size: 2.5rem;
+}
+
+.container {
+  max-width: 900px;
+  margin: 40px auto;
+  padding: 0 20px;
+}
+
+.account {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: 24px;
+}
+
+/* Panels */
+.panel {
+  background: white;
+  border-radius: 8px;
+  box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
+  padding: 24px;
+}
+
+.panel h2 {
+  color: var(--primary);
+}
+
+.panel-header {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  gap: 16px;
+  justify-content: space-between;
+  align-items: flex-start;
+}
+
+.panel-header > div {
+  flex: 1 1 320px;
+}
+
+.panel-intro,
+.muted {
+  color: var(--muted);
+}
+
+.panel-intro {
+  margin-top: 4px;
+  max-width: 60ch;
+}
+
+.notice {
+  background: #fff4e5;
+  border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);
+  padding: 10px 14px;
+  border-radius: 4px;
+  margin-top: 16px;
+}
+
+.status:empty {
+  display: none;
+}
+
+.status {
+  padding: 10px 14px;
+  border-radius: 4px;
+  background: #eef5ee;
+  color: var(--success);
+}
+
+.status[data-tone="error"] {
+  background: #fdecea;
+  color: var(--danger);
+}
+
+.status[data-tone="info"] {
+  background: #f3eeec;
+  color: var(--text);
+}
+
+/* Buttons */
+.btn,
+.btn-secondary,
+.btn-danger {
+  font: inherit;
+  font-size: 0.95rem;
+  border-radius: 5px;
+  padding: 8px 18px;
+  cursor: pointer;
+  border: 1px solid transparent;
+  transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s;
+}
+
+.btn {
+  background: var(--primary);
+  color: white;
+}
+
+.btn:hover {
+  background: #3e2723;
+}
+
+.btn-secondary {
+  background: white;
+  color: var(--primary);
+  border-color: var(--secondary);
+}
+
+.btn-secondary:hover {
+  background: #f5efed;
+}
+
+.btn-danger {
+  background: white;
+  color: var(--danger);
+  border-color: #f1c4c0;
+}
+
+.btn-danger:hover {
+  background: var(--danger);
+  color: white;
+}
+
+[aria-disabled="true"] {
+  opacity: 0.6;
+  cursor: progress;
+}
+
+:focus-visible {
+  outline: 3px solid var(--accent);
+  outline-offset: 2px;
+}
+
+/* Passkey list */
+.passkey-list {
+  list-style: none;
+  margin-top: 20px;
+  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
+}
+
+.passkey {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
+  gap: 16px;
+  align-items: center;
+  padding: 16px 0;
+  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
+}
+
+.passkey-icon {
+  display: grid;
+  place-items: center;
+  width: 48px;
+  height: 48px;
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  background: #f5efed;
+  color: var(--primary);
+}
+
+.passkey-name {
+  font-weight: 600;
+  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+}
+
+.passkey-provider,
+.passkey-dates {
+  font-size: 0.875rem;
+}
+
+.passkey-actions {
+  display: flex;
+  gap: 8px;
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 600px) {
+  .passkey {
+    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
+  }
+
+  .passkey-actions {
+    grid-column: 1 / -1;
+    justify-content: flex-end;
+  }
+}
+
+.empty {
+  margin-top: 20px;
+  padding: 24px;
+  text-align: center;
+  border: 2px dashed var(--border);
+  border-radius: 8px;
+}
+
+#passkey-loading {
+  margin-top: 20px;
+}
+
+/* Forms */
+.profile-form {
+  display: grid;
+  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
+  gap: 16px;
+  margin-top: 16px;
+  align-items: end;
+}
+
+.profile-form > div {
+  grid-column: 1 / -1;
+}
+
+label {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: 4px;
+  font-weight: 600;
+  font-size: 0.9rem;
+}
+
+input {
+  font: inherit;
+  font-weight: normal;
+  padding: 8px 10px;
+  border: 1px solid #bcaaa4;
+  border-radius: 5px;
+  background: white;
+  color: var(--text);
+}
+
+input:user-invalid {
+  border-color: var(--danger);
+}
+
+/* Dialogs */
+dialog {
+  margin: auto;
+  width: min(440px, calc(100% - 32px));
+  border: none;
+  border-radius: 10px;
+  padding: 24px;
+  color: var(--text);
+  box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
+}
+
+dialog h2 {
+  color: var(--primary);
+  font-size: 1.3rem;
+  margin-bottom: 8px;
+}
+
+dialog p {
+  margin-bottom: 12px;
+}
+
+dialog .field {
+  margin: 8px 0 4px;
+}
+
+/* Keep scroll gestures from chaining to the page behind the modal */
+dialog:modal {
+  overscroll-behavior: contain;
+}
+
+dialog::backdrop {
+  background: rgba(30, 18, 14, 0.55);
+  overflow: hidden;
+  overscroll-behavior: contain;
+}
+
+.dialog-actions {
+  display: flex;
+  justify-content: flex-end;
+  gap: 8px;
+  margin-top: 16px;
+}
+
+footer {
+  background: var(--secondary);
+  text-align: center;
+  padding: 40px 20px;
+  margin-top: 40px;
+}
+
+.footer-links {
+  margin-bottom: 20px;
+}
+
+.footer-links a {
+  margin: 0 10px;
+  color: var(--text);
+  text-decoration: none;
+  font-size: 0.85rem;
+}

+++ b/account/api.js
@@ -0,0 +1,239 @@
+// Account API client for the "My Account" page.
+//
+// Live contract (implemented by the Daily Grind backend):
+//   GET    /api/user                         -> { name, displayName, rpId, userId }
+//   PUT    /api/user        { name, displayName } -> { name, displayName, rpId, userId }
+//   GET    /api/credentials                  -> { rpId, userId, credentials: StoredPasskeyCredential[] }
+//   PUT    /api/credential/:id { name }      -> StoredPasskeyCredential
+//   DELETE /api/credential/:id               -> { success: true }
+//   POST   /api/passkey/registration-options -> PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON
+//   POST   /api/passkey/register  (credential.toJSON()) -> StoredPasskeyCredential
+//
+// All credential IDs and `userId` values are unpadded Base64URL strings, and
+// `rpId` is the server's configured RP ID (the same `rp.id` used at registration).
+//
+// The site is currently deployed as static files, so when `/api` isn't served
+// (non-JSON response or network failure) we fall back to an in-browser demo
+// backend persisted in localStorage. The demo backend is a stand-in for the
+// server only: it performs NO attestation verification and must never be used
+// as a real authentication store.
+
+const API_BASE = '/api';
+const JSON_HEADERS = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' };
+
+/** @typedef {{ ok: boolean, status: number, data: any }} ApiResult */
+
+let modePromise;
+
+/** Resolves to 'live' when the backend answers with JSON, otherwise 'demo'. */
+export function getMode() {
+  modePromise ??= (async () => {
+    try {
+      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/user`, { headers: JSON_HEADERS, credentials: 'same-origin' });
+      const isJson = res.headers.get('content-type')?.includes('application/json');
+      return isJson || res.status === 401 ? 'live' : 'demo';
+    } catch {
+      return 'demo';
+    }
+  })();
+  return modePromise;
+}
+
+async function request(method, path, body) {
+  if ((await getMode()) === 'demo') return demo.handle(method, path, body);
+
+  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + path, {
+    method,
+    headers: JSON_HEADERS,
+    credentials: 'same-origin',
+    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
+  });
+  if (res.status === 401) {
+    // Session expired: send the customer back through sign-in.
+    location.assign(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(location.pathname)}`);
+  }
+  const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
+  return { ok: res.ok, status: res.status, data };
+}
+
+export const getUser = () => request('GET', '/user');
+export const updateUser = (details) => request('PUT', '/user', details);
+export const listCredentials = () => request('GET', '/credentials');
+export const renameCredential = (id, name) => request('PUT', `/credential/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { name });
+export const deleteCredential = (id) => request('DELETE', `/credential/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
+export const getRegistrationOptions = () => request('POST', '/passkey/registration-options', {});
+export const registerCredential = (credentialJSON) => request('POST', '/passkey/register', credentialJSON);
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// AAGUID registry (UX hints only: provider name + icon, never for security)
+// Subset of https://github.com/passkeydeveloper/passkey-authenticator-aaguids
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+export const ZERO_AAGUID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
+let registryPromise;
+
+export function loadAaguidRegistry() {
+  registryPromise ??= fetch(new URL('./aaguids.json', import.meta.url))
+    .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : {}))
+    .catch(() => ({}));
+  return registryPromise;
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Demo backend (static hosting only)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+const DAY = 86_400_000;
+const STORE_KEY = 'daily-grind:demo-account';
+
+function toBase64Url(bytes) {
+  let bin = '';
+  for (const b of bytes) bin += String.fromCharCode(b);
+  return btoa(bin).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
+}
+
+function fromBase64Url(str) {
+  const b64 = str.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
+  const bin = atob(b64 + '='.repeat((4 - (b64.length % 4)) % 4));
+  return Uint8Array.from(bin, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
+}
+
+const randomId = (len = 16) => toBase64Url(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(len)));
+
+function bytesToUuid(bytes) {
+  const hex = Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
+  return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
+}
+
+const demo = {
+  // The real server reads its RP ID from configuration. The demo backend has no
+  // configuration, so it uses the host it is served from. The client never
+  // derives rpId itself: it always uses the value this "server" returns.
+  rpId: location.hostname,
+
+  load() {
+    try {
+      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY));
+      if (saved?.user && Array.isArray(saved.credentials)) return saved;
+    } catch { /* fall through to seed */ }
+    const now = Date.now();
+    const seeded = {
+      user: { name: 'jamie@example.com', displayName: 'Jamie Rivera', passkeyUserId: randomId() },
+      credentials: [
+        {
+          id: randomId(), aaguid: 'ea9b8d66-4d01-1d21-3ce4-b6b48cb575d4', name: 'Google Password Manager',
+          credentialDeviceType: 'multiDevice', credentialBackedUp: true, transports: ['internal', 'hybrid'],
+          registeredAt: now - 140 * DAY, lastUsedAt: now - 2 * DAY,
+        },
+        {
+          id: randomId(), aaguid: 'fbfc3007-154e-4ecc-8c0b-6e020557d7bd', name: 'Work MacBook',
+          credentialDeviceType: 'multiDevice', credentialBackedUp: true, transports: ['internal', 'hybrid'],
+          registeredAt: now - 60 * DAY, lastUsedAt: now - 21 * DAY,
+        },
+        {
+          id: randomId(), aaguid: 'cb69481e-8ff7-4039-93ec-0a2729a154a8', name: 'YubiKey 5 Series',
+          credentialDeviceType: 'singleDevice', credentialBackedUp: false, transports: ['usb', 'nfc'],
+          registeredAt: now - 300 * DAY,
+        },
+      ],
+    };
+    this.save(seeded);
+    return seeded;
+  },
+
+  save(state) {
+    localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
+  },
+
+  async handle(method, path, body) {
+    const state = this.load();
+    const { user } = state;
+    const ok = (data) => ({ ok: true, status: 200, data });
+    const notFound = () => ({ ok: false, status: 404, data: { error: 'Credential not found.' } });
+    const badRequest = (error) => ({ ok: false, status: 400, data: { error } });
+    const userPayload = () => ({ name: user.name, displayName: user.displayName, rpId: this.rpId, userId: user.passkeyUserId });
+
+    const credMatch = path.match(/^\/credential\/(.+)$/);
+
+    if (method === 'GET' && path === '/user') return ok(userPayload());
+
+    if (method === 'PUT' && path === '/user') {
+      const name = String(body?.name ?? '').trim();
+      const displayName = String(body?.displayName ?? '').trim();
+      if (!name || !displayName) return badRequest('Name and display name are required.');
+      Object.assign(user, { name, displayName });
+      this.save(state);
+      return ok(userPayload());
+    }
+
+    if (method === 'GET' && path === '/credentials') {
+      return ok({ rpId: this.rpId, userId: user.passkeyUserId, credentials: state.credentials });
+    }
+
+    if (credMatch) {
+      const id = decodeURIComponent(credMatch[1]);
+      const index = state.credentials.findIndex((c) => c.id === id);
+      if (index === -1) return notFound();
+
+      if (method === 'PUT') {
+        const name = String(body?.name ?? '').trim().slice(0, 64);
+        if (!name) return badRequest('A passkey name is required.');
+        state.credentials[index].name = name;
+        this.save(state);
+        return ok(state.credentials[index]);
+      }
+      if (method === 'DELETE') {
+        state.credentials.splice(index, 1);
+        this.save(state);
+        return ok({ success: true });
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (method === 'POST' && path === '/passkey/registration-options') {
+      const challenge = randomId(32);
+      sessionStorage.setItem(`${STORE_KEY}:challenge`, challenge);
+      return ok({
+        challenge,
+        rp: { id: this.rpId, name: 'The Daily Grind' },
+        user: { id: user.passkeyUserId, name: user.name, displayName: user.displayName },
+        pubKeyCredParams: [{ type: 'public-key', alg: -7 }, { type: 'public-key', alg: -257 }],
+        excludeCredentials: state.credentials.map((c) => ({ type: 'public-key', id: c.id, transports: c.transports })),
+        // Management flow: no authenticatorAttachment, so security keys are allowed too.
+        authenticatorSelection: { residentKey: 'required', requireResidentKey: true, userVerification: 'preferred' },
+        timeout: 300_000,
+      });
+    }
+
+    if (method === 'POST' && path === '/passkey/register') {
+      // A real server verifies the attestation, challenge, origin and UP flag with
+      // a vetted library (e.g. SimpleWebAuthn). The demo only checks the challenge
+      // and reads display metadata out of authenticatorData.
+      const expected = sessionStorage.getItem(`${STORE_KEY}:challenge`);
+      sessionStorage.removeItem(`${STORE_KEY}:challenge`);
+      try {
+        const clientData = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(fromBase64Url(body.response.clientDataJSON)));
+        if (!expected || clientData.challenge !== expected) return badRequest('Challenge mismatch.');
+        const authData = fromBase64Url(body.response.authenticatorData);
+        const flags = authData[32];
+        const aaguid = bytesToUuid(authData.slice(37, 53));
+        const registry = aaguid === ZERO_AAGUID ? {} : await loadAaguidRegistry();
+        const credential = {
+          id: body.id,
+          aaguid,
+          name: registry[aaguid]?.name || 'Unknown passkey provider',
+          credentialDeviceType: flags & 0x08 ? 'multiDevice' : 'singleDevice',
+          credentialBackedUp: Boolean(flags & 0x10),
+          transports: body.response.transports ?? [],
+          registeredAt: Date.now(),
+        };
+        state.credentials.push(credential);
+        this.save(state);
+        return ok(credential);
+      } catch {
+        return badRequest('Could not read the registration response.');
+      }
+    }
+
+    return { ok: false, status: 404, data: { error: 'Not found.' } };
+  },
+};

+import * as api from './api.js';
+
+// Load webauthn-polyfills (pinned + SRI via the page's import map) only where
+// getClientCapabilities / JSON (de)serialization helpers are missing.
+if (
+  window.PublicKeyCredential &&
+  (!PublicKeyCredential.getClientCapabilities ||
+    !PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON ||
+    !PublicKeyCredential.prototype.toJSON)
+) {
+  await import('webauthn-polyfills').catch((e) => console.warn('webauthn-polyfills failed to load:', e));
+}
+
+const $ = (sel) => document.querySelector(sel);
+
+const els = {
+  status: $('#account-status'),
+  demoNote: $('#demo-note'),
+  list: $('#passkey-list'),
+  loading: $('#passkey-loading'),
+  empty: $('#passkey-empty'),
+  rowTemplate: $('#passkey-row-template'),
+  createBtn: $('#create-passkey'),
+  unsupported: $('#passkey-unsupported'),
+  profileForm: $('#profile-form'),
+  renameDialog: $('#rename-dialog'),
+  renameForm: $('#rename-form'),
+  renameInput: $('#rename-input'),
+  deleteDialog: $('#delete-dialog'),
+  deleteName: $('#delete-name'),
+  deleteLastWarning: $('#delete-last-warning'),
+};
+
+const dateFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium' });
+
+/** Current server snapshot: { rpId, userId, credentials } */
+let snapshot = { rpId: '', userId: '', credentials: [] };
+let registry = {};
+let pendingCredentialId = null;
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Signal API helpers (progressive enhancement; failures are non-fatal)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+// Valid unpadded Base64URL: non-empty, [A-Za-z0-9_-] only, no '=' padding, length % 4 !== 1
+function isValidBase64Url(value) {
+  return typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0 && value.length % 4 !== 1 && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+async function syncAcceptedCredentials({ rpId, userId, credentials }) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential || !PublicKeyCredential.signalAllAcceptedCredentials) return;
+  const allAcceptedCredentialIds = credentials.map((c) => c.id);
+  if (!rpId || !isValidBase64Url(userId) || !allAcceptedCredentialIds.every(isValidBase64Url)) {
+    console.warn('signalAllAcceptedCredentials skipped: server rpId and valid Base64URL IDs are required.');
+    return;
+  }
+  try {
+    // rpId always comes from the server, never from window.location.hostname.
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalAllAcceptedCredentials({ rpId, userId, allAcceptedCredentialIds });
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.warn('signalAllAcceptedCredentials sync warning:', e);
+  }
+}
+
+async function syncCurrentUserDetails({ rpId, userId, name, displayName }) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential || !PublicKeyCredential.signalCurrentUserDetails) return;
+  if (!rpId || !isValidBase64Url(userId)) {
+    console.warn('signalCurrentUserDetails skipped: server rpId and valid Base64URL userId are required.');
+    return;
+  }
+  try {
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalCurrentUserDetails({ rpId, userId, name, displayName });
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.warn('signalCurrentUserDetails sync warning:', e);
+  }
+}
+
+async function signalUnknown(rpId, credentialId) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential || !PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential) return;
+  if (!rpId || !isValidBase64Url(credentialId)) return;
+  try {
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential({ rpId, credentialId });
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.warn('signalUnknownCredential sync warning:', e);
+  }
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Rendering
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+function announce(message, tone = 'info') {
+  els.status.dataset.tone = tone;
+  els.status.textContent = message;
+}
+
+function describeCredential(cred) {
+  const provider = cred.aaguid && cred.aaguid !== api.ZERO_AAGUID ? registry[cred.aaguid] : undefined;
+  return {
+    name: cred.name || provider?.name || 'Unknown passkey provider',
+    providerName: provider?.name,
+    icon: cred.providerIcon || provider?.icon_light,
+  };
+}
+
+function renderList() {
+  const { credentials } = snapshot;
+  els.loading.hidden = true;
+  els.empty.hidden = credentials.length > 0;
+  els.list.hidden = credentials.length === 0;
+
+  const rows = [...credentials]
+    .sort((a, b) => (b.lastUsedAt ?? b.registeredAt) - (a.lastUsedAt ?? a.registeredAt))
+    .map((cred) => {
+      const row = els.rowTemplate.content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);
+      const { name, providerName, icon } = describeCredential(cred);
+      row.dataset.id = cred.id;
+
+      const img = row.querySelector('.passkey-icon img');
+      if (icon) {
+        img.src = icon;
+        row.querySelector('.passkey-icon svg').remove();
+      } else {
+        img.remove(); // keep the generic key glyph
+      }
+
+      row.querySelector('.passkey-name').textContent = name;
+
+      const meta = [];
+      if (providerName && providerName !== name) meta.push(providerName);
+      meta.push(cred.credentialBackedUp ? 'Synced across devices' : 'This device only');
+      row.querySelector('.passkey-provider').textContent = meta.join(' · ');
+
+      const created = row.querySelector('.passkey-created');
+      created.dateTime = new Date(cred.registeredAt).toISOString();
+      created.textContent = dateFormat.format(cred.registeredAt);
+
+      const used = row.querySelector('.passkey-used');
+      if (cred.lastUsedAt) {
+        used.dateTime = new Date(cred.lastUsedAt).toISOString();
+        used.textContent = dateFormat.format(cred.lastUsedAt);
+      } else {
+        used.replaceWith('Never');
+      }
+
+      for (const btn of row.querySelectorAll('button[data-action]')) {
+        btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `${btn.textContent.trim()} ${name}`);
+      }
+      return row;
+    });
+
+  els.list.replaceChildren(...rows);
+}
+
+async function refreshCredentials() {
+  const res = await api.listCredentials();
+  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.data?.error || 'Could not load your passkeys.');
+  snapshot = res.data;
+  renderList();
+  return snapshot;
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Rename / delete
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+function findCredential(id) {
+  return snapshot.credentials.find((c) => c.id === id);
+}
+
+els.list.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
+  const button = event.target.closest('button[data-action]');
+  if (!button) return;
+  const id = button.closest('[data-id]').dataset.id;
+  const cred = findCredential(id);
+  if (!cred) return;
+  pendingCredentialId = id;
+
+  if (button.dataset.action === 'rename') {
+    els.renameInput.value = describeCredential(cred).name;
+    els.renameDialog.showModal();
+    els.renameInput.select();
+  } else if (button.dataset.action === 'delete') {
+    els.deleteName.textContent = describeCredential(cred).name;
+    els.deleteLastWarning.hidden = snapshot.credentials.length > 1;
+    els.deleteDialog.showModal();
+  }
+});
+
+els.renameDialog.addEventListener('close', async () => {
+  const { returnValue } = els.renameDialog;
+  els.renameDialog.returnValue = '';
+  const id = pendingCredentialId;
+  pendingCredentialId = null;
+  if (returnValue !== 'save' || !id) return;
+
+  const newName = els.renameInput.value.trim();
+  if (!newName || newName === describeCredential(findCredential(id) ?? {}).name) return;
+
+  // Renaming a passkey is a server-side label only: no Signal API call needed.
+  const res = await api.renameCredential(id, newName);
+  if (!res.ok) {
+    announce(res.data?.error || 'Sorry, we couldn’t rename that passkey.', 'error');
+    return;
+  }
+  await refreshCredentials();
+  announce(`Passkey renamed to “${newName}”.`, 'success');
+});
+
+els.deleteDialog.addEventListener('close', async () => {
+  const { returnValue } = els.deleteDialog;
+  els.deleteDialog.returnValue = '';
+  const id = pendingCredentialId;
+  pendingCredentialId = null;
+  if (returnValue !== 'delete' || !id) return;
+
+  const name = describeCredential(findCredential(id) ?? {}).name;
+  const res = await api.deleteCredential(id);
+  if (!res.ok) {
+    announce(res.data?.error || 'Sorry, we couldn’t remove that passkey.', 'error');
+    return;
+  }
+  const latest = await refreshCredentials();
+  announce(`“${name}” was removed from your account.`, 'success');
+  // Tell the password manager which passkeys are still valid so it hides the deleted one.
+  await syncAcceptedCredentials(latest);
+});
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Account details (username / display name) -> signalCurrentUserDetails
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+async function loadProfile() {
+  const res = await api.getUser();
+  if (!res.ok) return;
+  els.profileForm.elements.name.value = res.data.name;
+  els.profileForm.elements.displayName.value = res.data.displayName;
+  $('#greeting-name').textContent = res.data.displayName;
+}
+
+els.profileForm.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  const form = els.profileForm;
+  const submit = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
+  const name = form.elements.name.value.trim();
+  const displayName = form.elements.displayName.value.trim();
+
+  submit.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
+  try {
+    const res = await api.updateUser({ name, displayName });
+    if (!res.ok) {
+      announce(res.data?.error || 'Sorry, we couldn’t update your details.', 'error');
+      return;
+    }
+    $('#greeting-name').textContent = res.data.displayName;
+    announce('Your account details were saved.', 'success');
+    await syncCurrentUserDetails({
+      rpId: res.data.rpId,
+      userId: res.data.userId,
+      name: res.data.name,
+      displayName: res.data.displayName,
+    });
+  } finally {
+    submit.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
+  }
+});
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Create passkey (management flow: platform authenticators and security keys)
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+async function isPasskeySupported() {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential || !PublicKeyCredential.getClientCapabilities) return false;
+  try {
+    const caps = await PublicKeyCredential.getClientCapabilities();
+    return Boolean(caps.passkeyPlatformAuthenticator ?? caps.userVerifyingPlatformAuthenticator);
+  } catch {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+
+els.createBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  if (els.createBtn.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return;
+  els.createBtn.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
+  try {
+    const optionsRes = await api.getRegistrationOptions();
+    if (!optionsRes.ok) {
+      announce('We couldn’t start passkey setup. Please try again.', 'error');
+      return;
+    }
+    const publicKey = PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON(optionsRes.data);
+
+    let credential;
+    try {
+      credential = await navigator.credentials.create({ publicKey });
+    } catch (err) {
+      if (err.name === 'InvalidStateError') announce('You already have a passkey for this account on that device or password manager.', 'info');
+      else if (err.name === 'SecurityError') announce('Passkeys aren’t available on this connection. Please make sure you’re on our secure site.', 'error');
+      else if (err.name !== 'NotAllowedError' && err.name !== 'AbortError') announce('Passkey setup didn’t complete.', 'error');
+      return; // user cancellations stay silent
+    }
+
+    const encoded = credential.toJSON();
+    let saved = false;
+    try {
+      const res = await api.registerCredential(encoded);
+      saved = res.ok;
+    } catch (e) {
+      console.warn('Passkey registration request failed:', e);
+    }
+    if (!saved) {
+      // Server rejected it: tell the password manager to drop the orphaned passkey.
+      await signalUnknown(optionsRes.data.rp?.id, encoded.id);
+      announce('We couldn’t save that passkey. Please try again.', 'error');
+      return;
+    }
+    await refreshCredentials();
+    announce('Passkey created. You can now sign in without a password.', 'success');
+  } finally {
+    els.createBtn.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
+  }
+});
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Init
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+async function init() {
+  const [mode, supported, reg] = await Promise.all([api.getMode(), isPasskeySupported(), api.loadAaguidRegistry()]);
+  registry = reg;
+  els.demoNote.hidden = mode !== 'demo';
+  els.createBtn.hidden = !supported;
+  els.unsupported.hidden = supported;
+
+  loadProfile().catch((e) => console.warn('Could not load profile:', e));
+
+  try {
+    const latest = await refreshCredentials();
+    // Keep the browser's passkey provider in lockstep with the server on every visit.
+    await syncAcceptedCredentials(latest);
+  } catch (e) {
+    els.loading.hidden = true;
+    announce(e.message, 'error');
+  }
+}
+
+init();
